items.title: Prevent overlapping background update checks
items.description: Replace or protect timer callbacks so general updates, Asset Tracker, and PBE status checks cannot overlap, propagate unhandled exceptions, or continue after cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: Each background job has independent concurrency protection.
All jobs support cancellation during shutdown and settings reload.
Timer callback exceptions are logged with their complete stack trace.
No async void method remains outside framework event boundaries.

items.title: Complete MainWindow shutdown cleanup
items.description: Stop background update services and detach all singleton service events registered by MainWindow before the application closes.
acceptanceCriteria: UpdateCheckService is stopped during shutdown.
Comparator, extraction, backup, version, update, and progress events are detached symmetrically.
No UI callback executes after MainWindow begins closing.

items.title: Make configuration persistence atomic and recoverable
items.description: Write configuration through a temporary file, keep a valid backup, serialize concurrent saves, and recover automatically when the primary JSON is corrupt.
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration writes use a temporary file and atomic replacement.
A last-known-good backup is maintained.
Concurrent synchronous and asynchronous saves cannot overlap.
Startup restores the backup when the primary file is invalid.
Recovery and failures are logged.

items.title: Make history cleanup truthful and recoverable
items.description: Stop suppressing deletion failures and retain history references for entries whose physical data could not be removed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every failed deletion is logged with its exception.
Failed entries remain visible or are marked for retry.
The result reports deleted items, failed items, and recovered disk space.
No empty catch block remains in history cleanup.

items.title: Reduce memory usage during PNG export
items.description: Avoid retaining redundant full-image buffers and remove unnecessary nested Task.Run calls while preserving responsive UI during large exports.
acceptanceCriteria: PNG data is encoded directly to the destination when safe.
Large captures expose cancellation.
Export validates dimensions and estimated memory before rendering.
Image Merger export does not block the UI thread for large images.

items.title: Expand automated regression coverage
items.description: Add permanent tests for comparison, packaging, extraction, history, update scheduling, audio linking, parsers, and Viewer cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: ~~WadComparatorService and WadPackagingService have regression tests.~~
~~Extraction and historical reconstruction have success, cancellation, and corruption tests.~~
~~Update scheduling tests cover overlap and shutdown.~~
~~Viewer and audio resource cleanup have lifecycle tests where technically feasible.~~

items.title: Introduce nullable analysis and targeted analyzers
items.description: Enable nullable reference analysis incrementally and add rules for lost tasks, disposable resources, event lifecycle, and exception handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Nullable analysis is enabled first for new files and Core services.
Analyzer warnings are introduced without a global warning-suppression baseline.
Rules detect discarded tasks and undisposed resources.
The application builds without new analyzer warnings in migrated areas.

items.title: Split oversized UI controllers by responsibility
items.description: Extract independently testable operations from Explorer, Viewer, JSON diff, SKN diff, and API controls without performing a disruptive full MVVM rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Explorer actions are separated from selection and navigation lifecycle.
Viewer loading coordination is separated from viewport rendering.
Diff navigation and metric calculation are independently testable.
Sales, Mythic Shop, and Pass Rewards presentation logic is separated.

items.title: Optimize Hash Guessing pipelines
items.description: Reduce repeated sorting, materialization, corpus reads, wordlist rebuilding, and large-buffer allocation across guessing phases.
acceptanceCriteria: ~~Corpus indexes are reused by revision, extension, prefix, and basename.~~
~~Large GREP inputs avoid redundant full-buffer copies when materialization is required by the WAD reader.~~
~~Normalized wordlists are reused between compatible phases.~~
~~The HUD reports guesses per second, discarded candidates, elapsed time, and memory.~~
Each phase has a reproducible performance benchmark.
Long sessions can optionally resume from a checkpoint.

items.title: Add a memory-budgeted WAD preview cache
items.description: Cache recent WAD headers, decompressed previews, thumbnails, parsed BIN results, and resolved HIRC data under an explicit LRU memory budget.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache size is configurable with safe presets.
Entries are evicted through an LRU policy.
Mount changes invalidate incompatible cache entries.
Hit rate, miss rate, size, and eviction count are observable.
Users can release the cache manually.

items.title: Standardize safe asynchronous execution
items.description: Remove unnecessary dispatcher and Task.Run usage and centralize logging for intentionally discarded asynchronous operations.
acceptanceCriteria: No Task.Run is used for trivial synchronous file existence checks.
Nested Dispatcher.InvokeAsync async delegates are replaced with explicit awaited flows.
Intentional fire-and-forget operations use one logging helper.
Cancellation and owner lifecycle are propagated consistently.

items.title: Add combinable technical filters
items.description: Filter Explorer results by extension, size, source WAD, hash resolution, compression, preview support, regex, and case sensitivity.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple filters can be active simultaneously.
Filtering remains asynchronous and cancelable.
Active filters are visible and individually removable.
Filters work consistently in LIVE, PBE, LOCAL, and RESULTS modes.

items.title: Show calculated folder statistics
items.description: Display file count, compressed and uncompressed size, dominant extensions, unknown hashes, and WAD distribution for the selected folder.
acceptanceCriteria: Statistics are calculated outside the UI thread.
Calculation can be canceled when selection changes.
Large folders show progressive or indeterminate feedback.
Repeated selection can reuse valid cached statistics.

items.title: Implement a hexadecimal viewer
items.description: Provide structured fallback inspection for unsupported binary files with offsets, hex, ASCII, search, endianness, range export, and magic-signature detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Large files are virtualized and are not loaded as formatted strings in full.
Users can search text and byte patterns.
Selected byte ranges can be exported.
Known magic signatures and basic metadata are displayed.
Historical WAD content never falls back to current local bytes.

items.title: Add Open As parser override
items.description: Allow users to force BIN, texture, audio, JSON, plain text, or hexadecimal parsing for extensionless or incorrectly named files.
acceptanceCriteria: Open As is available from the file context menu.
Parser failures return to the original preview state.
The override affects only the current preview unless explicitly persisted.

items.title: Add advanced comparison filters
items.description: Filter results by absolute and percentage size delta, compression transition, extension, source WAD, rename state, hash resolution, and semantic equivalence.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters combine with existing search and result type filters.
Users can isolate binary changes that are semantically equivalent.
Filtering does not reload archived content.
Current filter state is reflected in overview metrics.

items.title: Export patch statistics
items.description: Generate CSV and JSON summaries for WAD growth, extension distribution, largest assets, result types, and total space added or removed.
acceptanceCriteria: Statistics respect active result filters.
Exports include comparison version and source paths.
CSV output is compatible with common spreadsheet applications.
JSON output has a documented stable schema.

items.title: Recompare a selected subset
items.description: Allow selected WADs, folders, or result groups to be compared again without repeating the entire original comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select one or more WADs or folders from results.
The new run preserves original comparison context.
Progress and cancellation use the standard progress protocol.

items.title: Add diagnostic image comparison modes
items.description: Add before-and-after slider, blink, heatmap, amplified difference, RGB-only, alpha-only, MAE, PSNR, and changed-pixel percentage modes.
acceptanceCriteria: All modes preserve original image dimensions and alpha semantics.
Metric calculation runs outside the UI thread and supports cancellation.
Users can export the currently selected diagnostic view.
Mismatched dimensions have an explicit alignment policy.

items.title: Expand Image Merger layout and export controls
items.description: Add uniform scaling, explicit cell size, background selection, labels, drag-and-drop ordering, outer padding, additional formats, and automatic output splitting.
acceptanceCriteria: Item order can be changed through drag and drop.
Cell size, inner gap, and outer padding are independent.
Transparent, checkerboard, and solid backgrounds are supported.
Optional labels use asset names.
Oversized output can be split safely into multiple images.

items.title: Add waveform and spectrogram inspection
items.description: Visualize decoded audio with waveform, spectrogram, duration, sample rate, channels, bitrate, loop points, range selection, and optional normalization.
acceptanceCriteria: WEM, OGG, and MP3 assets display technical metadata.
Waveform generation is cached and cancelable.
Long audio files use downsampled visualization data.
Selected ranges can be previewed and exported.
Loop metadata is displayed when available.

items.title: Add synchronized A/B audio comparison
items.description: Compare OLD and NEW audio with shared position, matched volume, instant switching, synchronized loops, and duration or loudness deltas.
acceptanceCriteria: OLD and NEW share one transport position.
Switching sources does not restart playback.
Volume normalization can be enabled or disabled.
Duration and approximate loudness differences are displayed.

items.title: Add 3D diagnostic rendering modes
items.description: Add wireframe, normals, UV checker, bone weights, skeleton overlay, bounds, viewport mesh isolation, and scene statistics.
acceptanceCriteria: Diagnostic modes can be enabled independently.
Users can select, isolate, and hide meshes from the viewport.
The HUD displays vertices, triangles, materials, meshes, and bones.
Modes release GPU and event resources when the view unloads.
Normal viewing performance is unaffected when diagnostics are disabled.

items.title: Add an animation inspector
items.description: Provide animated-joint inventory, precise timeline scrubbing, frame stepping, playback speed, keyframe data, and optional two-animation comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline supports precise seek and frame stepping.
Animated joints, duration, frame rate, and keyframe counts are visible.
Playback speed does not alter source timing metadata.
Two compatible animations can be compared when enabled.

items.title: Evaluate glTF or GLB technical export
items.description: Assess and implement model or scene export to glTF or GLB when LeagueToolkit exposes sufficient geometry, skeleton, material, and animation data.
acceptanceCriteria: A feasibility spike documents supported and unsupported source data.
Export preserves mesh transforms and material assignments.
Skeleton and animation export is included only when structurally valid.
Unsupported data is reported instead of silently discarded.

items.title: Add a storage auditor
items.description: Report disk usage for backups, history, Shadow Cache, thumbnails, temporary media, API cache, logs, and orphaned files with selective cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Usage is grouped by storage category.
Orphaned data is detected without deleting it automatically.
Users see estimated recoverable space before confirmation.
Cleanup can target individual categories.
Failures are reported without removing their references.

items.title: Verify and repair backup integrity
items.description: Validate snapshot indexes, chunk accessibility, sizes, optional checksums, audio dependencies, and incomplete archives, then offer safe repair or removal.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation works without accessing current LIVE or PBE content.
Missing indexes, chunks, and audio dependencies are reported separately.
Checksum verification is optional for large archives.
Repairs never replace archived content with current local content.
Irreparable snapshots require explicit confirmation before deletion.

items.title: Add configurable retention policies
items.description: Automatically plan retention by version count, patch, disk budget, and protected favorites while providing a dry-run before deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Policies support latest N versions, one per patch, and maximum disk usage.
Protected or favorite backups are never selected automatically.
A dry-run lists every proposed deletion and estimated recovered space.
Retention cleanup uses the same truthful deletion reporting as history cleanup.
